name: Phantom Beacon

authors.name: Operation Coinnectar Crew (HaxNation x FOSS Mumbai 2026)

description:
One internal service exposes a Coinnectar auto-update / telemetry endpoint. curl it and you get a bland {"status":"ok"} — a healthy CDN, nothing to see. The implant that actually talks to it disagrees.

Make the endpoint talk the way the implant does, and read what it hands back. Everything you need to sound like the implant is in the captured client.
hints: The server is picky about who's asking — the same trick as Cobalt Strike malleable profiles and APT28 loaders. The client builds that identity at runtime instead of storing it in the clear.
Once you have it, replay it exactly: the request builder (or curl -A) is enough.
